STROBE & FLASHING WARNING

This game has flashing and strobing lights, rapid colour changes, pulsing tunnels and fast motion. These can trigger seizures in people with photosensitive epilepsy, even if they have never had one.

In VR it can also cause dizziness, nausea or disorientation. Stop playing straight away if you feel unwell, see odd visual effects, or get headaches, and take a break at least every 30 minutes.

If you or anyone in your family has epilepsy or a seizure history, talk to a doctor before playing. There are comfort options in Settings › Comfort (reduce flashing, reduce motion, steady horizon).


You will see this every time the game starts.
